cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

mechanism: A mirrors presentation confidence despite misunderstanding equipment cues, trying to secure an apology before the public moment.
confusable: D03 hints at offense; S04 must produce a real mistaken inference that A covers.
comparison: Work presentation and technical cue differ from a meal toast.
seedUse: Use D03-b before-arrival pressure and demand for spoken remorse; avoid copying its emoji mechanism.
